folders.title: Music folders
folders.help: Choose the folders where you keep music. These folders are read but not altered.

fromRekordbox.title: Start from rekordbox
fromRekordbox.help: Your rekordbox tracks become Library tracks. Nothing changes in rekordbox or in your files.

fresh.title: Start fresh
fresh.help: An empty Library. Add the tracks you want from All music.

inbox.title: Where do you put new music?
inbox.help: Choose the folder where new music lands. It is read, never changed. Skip it if you would rather not say.
inbox.watchHelp: Off until you turn it on. When on, new files in this folder show up in the Inbox as they arrive.
